meta.description: Erik Serrano is a postdoctoral researcher at KTH Royal Institute of Technology using computational tools to understand biology through image-based profiling, reproducible scientific software, and open science.

profile.name: Erik Serrano
profile.tagline: Computational biologist and scientific software developer focused on image-based profiling.
profile.summary: I use computational tools to understand biology and build reproducible, open-source software that helps researchers turn large-scale cellular imaging experiments into interpretable biological insight.

paragraphs: I am a postdoctoral researcher at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Sweden, working at the intersection of computational biology, image-based profiling, and open-source scientific software.

My research centers on using computational tools to understand cellular biology from high-dimensional morphology data. I care deeply about software that is transparent, scalable, easy to use, and useful to other scientists long after a single project ends.

Before joining KTH, I completed doctoral training in Computational Bioscience at the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, where I contributed to open tools for cytomining and large-scale biological data analysis.
